title: The demo-trim map of ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.10 belongs to 1.0.10 (contract and baseHash of its own three files), and build-joomla-demo-trim.mjs --check turns red on any Joomla demo-trim map on disk that names another contract or another baseHash; --contract builds and checks a release its design is not pinned to yet
steps: The test copies ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.9, ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.10 and tracy-business/j6/1.2.6 into a temporary contracts tree (TRACY_JOOMLA_CONTRACTS) and runs the script against it: as committed, with 1.0.9's map copied over 1.0.10's, with a wrong baseHash, with a hide row dropped, and rebuilt with --contract.
expect: The run exits 0 with 6 tests passing and 0 failing.
With 1.0.9's map copied into 1.0.10, plain --check exits 1 and names the wrong contract and the wrong baseHash.
A map naming its own contract with a baseHash that is not the Claude Cowork plugin's formula over its three files fails --check.

--contract ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.10 writes a map naming 1.0.10 whose baseHash is sha256 of 'manifest.json:<sha>
content-map.json:<sha>
presentation-lock.json:<sha>
', keeping the Kinetic design's demoTrimKeep page.
A stale hide list with the right contract and baseHash passes plain --check but fails --check --contract ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.10; an id with no contract directory is refused.
evidence: tasks/nhat-ky/2026-10-21-kinetic-demo-trim.md. ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.10 (cut in #1552) carried a copy of 1.0.9's map (contract ja-kinetic/j6/1.0.9, baseHash 60b5299b…); Claude Cowork's DemoTrimProfile refused it with 'The demo-trim profile does not belong to this contract', while --check exited 0 because it only read pinned contracts.
fence: What this repository generates and checks. Not covered: the Claude Cowork for Joomla release carrying the map, and a site running demoTrim on 1.0.10.

tests: the committed maps pass --check, including the not-yet-pinned release
--check is red on a map copied from the previous release
--check is red on a map naming its own contract with a stale baseHash
--contract builds a release the design is not pinned to, with the design keep set
--contract is red when the pinned list leaves the release stale
--contract refuses an id with no contract
